I checked the letter against the fact sheet point.

**benchmark — not conveyed.** The letter reports the account's own returns (3.7% net, 3.9% gross, 5.3% YTD, 8.2% since inception) but never mentions the age-based policy blend comparison index or its 4.1% Q2 2026 return. There is no benchmark comparison anywhere in the letter, so the reader cannot see that the account trailed its index for the quarter.

points.evidence: The letter's performance paragraph lists only account-level results — "a return of 3.7% net of fees (3.9% gross of fees)", "5.3% net of fees" year to date, and "8.2% net of fees" annualized since inception. No comparison index, age-based policy blend, or 4.1% figure appears anywhere in the letter, and no other passage references a benchmark.
